items.text: Iswamaenenoo kwaŋin kanuka nolimon lotobait, ido kanuka nolimerekek, kanuka ninimcrekek yenikiliokit, arai kanuka ŋinikalol da.
Kwape ejaar etiai loitemokinete, iswamakinete kwaŋin ŋinidiopet, kwape ejaar etiaiakee.
Iurian kere iswamaete akiro nun kopone kanol, naeinakiniata ainakinet naeinakinere kakim, naka asakat naeur saa mama ejai EJAKAIT.

Arai kiboikin imoit nepepe kayes, arai ice kere yenejaun kidinikus katuriokus kere, kosodi ainakin ainakinet naeinakinere kakim, naka asakat naeur saa mama ejai EJAKAIT; kwape iswamaata yesi, iswamai ŋesi da kwaŋin,
Kanuka atukot, ejaun ekisil ediopet kanukus, ido kanuka imoit yeniboienenei nepepe kayes, ekisil lomam edaun katuriokus kere: kwape iiaatar yesi, ejaun kwaŋin imoit kakonyen nuka EJAKAIT,
Ejaun ekisil ediopet ka aicorakinet adiopet kanukus, ido kanuka imoit yeniboienenei kayes.”
“Kolimok idwe luka Isirael ebe, Naidolioto akwap naketolomari yes,
Ejaun kwana, ebe, nainyamiata atap naka akwap, iinakinete ainakinet nadakakina mama ejai EJAKAIT.
Iinanakinete aluŋuret naka agweikus nainumanariata yesi kanuka ainakinet nadakakina: kwape idakuniata ainakinet nadakakina naka epejal, idakunete nin da kwaŋin,
linanakinete EJAKAIT aluŋuret naka agweikus nainumanariata araun ainakinet nadakakina katuriokus kere.
Ido naipaariata, komam iricito aicorakineta nun kere, nualimoki EJAKAIT Musa.
Ŋun kere nukicorak yes EJAKAIT kama ka Musa, ameun kapaaran naesiaunia EJAKAIT aicorakin, anatar aturiokus kere;

Ejaun kwana, arai kibueasi, komam ekodet ejeŋi, einakini ekodet kere emoŋ lotobait kanuka ainakinet naicweio, naka asakat naeur saa mama ejai EJAKAIT, nepepe kainakineteke naka akiria, ka ainakineteke namatat, kwape ejaar ekisil, ka ekoroi ediopet kanuka ainakinet naka adiakaret.

Eluei esasedoti ekodet kere loka idwe luka Isirael, isionio da kes; naarai arai aibucaret, ayaut da ainakinetekee, ainakinet naeinakinere kakim mama ejai EJAKAIT, ka ainakinetekee naka adiakaret kakonyen nuka EJAKAIT, kanuka aibucaretekec:
Isionio ekodet kere loka idwe luka Isirael, ka imoit da yeniboienenei kamakee; naarai arai aibucaret naka ituŋa kere komam ejenete.
Ido arai kediaka idiopetunanan komam ejeŋi, einakini akinei naka ekaru ediopet araun ainakinet naka adiakaret.
Eluei esasedoti aijar naibuearit, naediakaria komam ejeŋi, kakonyen nuka EJAKAIT, alueio ŋes; ido isionio ŋes.
Ŋaunos kekisil ediopet kanuka nin yeniswamai ibore komam ejeŋi, nin yeneurikinitai odwe luka Isirael, ido ka imoit yeniboienenei kamakee.
Konye aijar naepeleikin aswam ibore, arai iuriat arai imoit, einyanakini nin EJAKAIT; egelario ituŋanan nin kotuŋake.
Naarai amwaŋ akirot naka EJAKAIT, abil da aicorakineteke; egelario ituŋanan ŋin cut, ejaunos numam adoliteke mamake.”
Naajaatar idwe luka Isirael amodiŋ apotu kodumut etuŋanan erarai akito kapaaran nakasabato,
Koyaut luadumunete ŋes erarai akito mama ejai Musa ka Aaron ido mama ejai ekodet kere.
Koenai, naarai mam ber alimoritai nuiswamakinio ŋes.
Kotema EJAKAIT Musa atiar, “Abeit eario etuŋanan: ibiribiri ekodet kere ŋes kamor kokina kiidukurun.”
Koyau ekodet kere ŋes kina kiidukurun, kibiribiroto ŋes kamor, kotwana; kwape kicorakinia EJAKAIT Musa.
“Kolimok idwe luka Isirael, kicorak kes aiswamakin isilo atokito nuka inapenekee, anatar aturiokee kere, kitolomikis eusi lobululu osilo luka niuitokiroit:
Eraun kamakus esilot, tetere iteete ŋes, kiitununoto aicorakineta kere nuka EJAKAIT, kiswamata kes; komam ilosete koipud loka etaukus ka akonyenekus loetapitor yes aelor:
Tetere iitunete iswamaete da akaieorakineta kere, koraunos lukalaunak kama ejai Edekekus.
Arai eoŋ EJAKAIT Ekusideke, loketolomuni yes kakwap nako Misiri, araun Edekekus: arai eoŋ EJAKAIT Ekusideke.”
